Support

A question, a problem, or a policy that needs a closer look?

Email nickcottier@icloud.com. Include your device model, iOS version and what happened. For policy corrections, include the policy title, party and a link to the official source.

Please don’t send your political opinions or private notes unless you deliberately want to share them. Check screenshots before attaching them.

Beta testing

Policy Match is being prepared for TestFlight. A public invitation link will be added here when external testing is available. There is no live sign-up link yet.

If you already have an invitation, install Apple’s TestFlight app and follow the invitation. You can send feedback through TestFlight or email support. Beta builds may contain bugs and expire; they are not a substitute for a backup.

Common questions

How is my match calculated?

Strongly disagree = 0, disagree = 25, unsure = 50, agree = 75 and strongly agree = 100. Each party’s percentage is the average for its active policies you have rated. Every rated policy has equal weight. Unanswered policies are excluded. An “unsure” response counts as 50; clear the response to exclude it.

Parties have different numbers of listed policies, and your rated sample may be small. Treat the result as a summary of your answers, not a voting recommendation.

Will restarting my phone delete my responses?

No. Responses are saved locally and normally survive restarting the device or updating the app. Deleting the app, losing or resetting the device, or a storage failure may permanently remove them. Policy Match has no account-based recovery or iCloud sync. A device backup may restore them if they were included; recovery is not guaranteed.

How do I get new policies?

Open About → Policy updates → Check for updates. You can also enable automatic downloads there. The app checks the signature and integrity of an update before accepting it. If a download fails, it keeps its existing policy list. Browsing and rating downloaded policies works offline.

Why does a corrected policy need a new response?

When a commitment materially changes, it gets a new identity and starts unanswered. Your old response is not carried over to different wording. Responses to retired policies remain stored locally, but those policies no longer affect the current match.

How do I remove a response or all my data?

Use Clear response for an individual opinion. To remove every response and note, go to About → Clear all responses and confirm. This cannot be undone. Clearing responses does not delete the public policy catalogue.

Is this an official election app?

No. Policy Match is an independent comparison tool, not affiliated with the Electoral Commission or any political party. Always consult the linked official party source for the full commitment, conditions and latest wording.
